supersession_reason: Version 1 named a ten-second hold but omitted the raw sample contract and numeric hold criteria. Version 2 reuses the already-locked causal-standing v1 absolute hold limits without changing plant safety limits or product authority.
change_control: Never edit this file after its protocol commit. Add a new version and record why the development contract changed.
execution_rule: Run layers in order and stop at the first FAIL, INVALID, or BLOCKED layer.

ControlsOff.acceptance: The full-simulation plant remains finite and below the locked explosion limits without actuation. Falling under gravity is not failure.

DampingOnly.acceptance: The same plant remains finite and below the locked explosion limits with damping but no positional strength. Falling under gravity is not failure.

FixedNeutralTarget.acceptance: Every physics sample satisfies hold_acceptance for the complete window while all topology and assistance invariants remain true.

ZeroActions.acceptance: Every physics sample satisfies hold_acceptance; successful inference is conditioned to zero; the real target path meets cadence and readback requirements.

RealOnnxPolicy.acceptance: Every physics sample satisfies hold_acceptance; the existing ONNX and real target path meet cadence and readback requirements. This layer does not by itself confer product success.

verdict_rules.PASS: The current layer satisfies every invariant and its layer-specific acceptance rule using raw UE runtime observations.
verdict_rules.FAIL: The run is well formed but violates an invariant or layer-specific behavioral rule.
verdict_rules.INVALID: The protocol linkage, requested layer, raw observations, cadence, or evidence artifact is malformed or incomplete.
verdict_rules.BLOCKED: The UE project, map, Manny asset, Physics Control capability, or existing ONNX required by the layer is unavailable before execution.

product_success: Never. Product success remains exclusively governed by locked causal-standing product protocol execution.
